technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but severely undermined by bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, below cloud); volume spike and OBV divergence suggest potential reversal but lack trend confirmation and ADX strength.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces earnings in 33 days with no fundamental tailwinds.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and minimal; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (394.56) with flat yield curve and recent FOMC decision create severely unfavourable macro backdrop; 33-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 oversold with stochRSI cross-up and 15x volume spike create classic reversal setup in extreme fear regime (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 93.62.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with active death cross, MACD negative, Ichimoku below cloud, weak ADX trend (23.86), zero fundamental conviction, and 33-day earnings event risk in hostile macro environment eliminate entry quality despite oversold technicals.
